title: 奮い立たせてくれるもの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Kokura Kinen just around the corner, Nice Nature becomes discouraged after seeing Tokai Teio's brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To help rekindle Nice Nature's spirits, I take her to the shopping district in Kokura to mingle with the locals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After meeting the locals, Nice Nature manages to brighten back up, just as I hoped.
